Explain hashing

1. Why hashing?

  • Comparison sorts need Ω(nlog⁡n)\Omega(n \log n)Ω(nlogn) time.

  • Linear probing: h′(k,i):=(h(k)+i) mod mh'(k, i) := (h(k) + i) \bmod mh′(k,i):=(h(k)+i)modm.

With a load factor α:=n/m\alpha := n/mα:=n/m each slot holds about α\alphaα keys.

h(a,b)(k):=((ak+b) mod p) mod mh_{(a,b)}(k) := ((ak + b) \bmod p) \bmod mh(a,b)​(k):=((ak+b)modp)modm

That family is universal.
